item.text: {"action":"experiment","hypothesis":"A05’s pooled improvement over G01 may be supplied largely by specializing the large other route, while the cu_o expert may mainly shift errors between reported-zero and positive-Tc cases. The complementary ablation to L004—retaining only an extra_trees/raw other expert and allowing cu_o and fe_anion to fall back to the global extra_trees/raw model—will isolate the contribution of other-route specialization. Subgroup improvements without both conditions are only tradeoffs.","reason":"The required successful-unique-cycle minimum is still pending.
